note: RFC 4271 Section 6.2 says: All errors detected while processing the OPEN message MUST be indicated by sending the NOTIFICATION message with the Error Code OPEN Message Error. Tested is "NOTIFICATION message with the Error Code OPEN Message Error"; Gap is "All errors detected"; Producer is internal/component/bgp/reactor/session_handlers.go::handleOpen. The ordinary and pending matrices present three standard/RFC9072 outer-length failures with legal message-header lengths. Both now reach Session.admitOpen, UnpackOpen and rejectOpenCapabilityError; they require exact NOTIFICATION 2/0, ordinary Idle or retained incumbent OpenConfirm, and cleared pending admission. The pending fixture first reads its independent connection's local OPEN before sending malformed input, preserving the refusal assertions. Exact-length ordinary controls require KEEPALIVE and OpenConfirm; the valid pending collision requires Cease 6/7 and an unchanged incumbent. These controls distinguish framing refusal from unconditional OPEN or collision refusal. The handleOpen extraction delegates decoding and validation without changing this tested obligation. The matrices do not enumerate every OPEN validation class, assert TCP EOF independently, or prove universal incoming admission; this remains partial with zero whole-requirement credit.
